subject: Upfront commit schedule and pricing exceptions
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Converting to annual upfront commit — questions on discounts & ramp

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. We are interested in switching Acme Health from monthly invoicing to an annual upfront commitment to reduce unit cost, but we have a few constraints and questions before we move to legal:

- Can you outline the discount tiers for a 12-month, 24-month, and 36-month upfront commitment?
- We expect usage to ramp over Q3–Q4 (40% of final run-rate in Q3, 70% in Q4). Are ramp schedules supported for recognizing committed capacity and pricing?
- Any standard concessions you offer for public sector / health customers around data retention or audit windows?

If you can send a short offer with the proposed ramp-friendly billing/crediting approach and any one-time onboarding credits, I can share with procurement.

Appreciate it —
Lena Ortiz
Head of Integrations, Acme Health
